_comment: Production gateway env profile for the generation child (red-team B7). Holds NO project, folder or secret values.
GEMINI_MODEL is deliberately absent: the model is a REQUIRED harness argument (--model) and is recorded in every
result, because the live install and the code/TF defaults disagree (FD-07 D1: live gemini-3.8-flash vs
infra/platform/main.tf gemini-3.7-flash) and the owner has not chosen.
Values must match the gateway Cloud Run service env in infra/platform/main.tf (tests/test_eval_prod_env.py).
Behavior flags the TF does not set (ENABLE_DEVELOPER_SWARM, ENABLE_DUAL_ARCHITECT_CONSENSUS, ARCHITECT_CRITIC_MODEL)
are left unset so the product's own defaults apply, exactly as in production.
